initial_scene: The egocentric view shows both robot forearms reaching from the lower sides of the image toward a three-level wooden shelf. A blue, white and red Rubik's cube sits on its lowest tray. Both hands initially open; the right hand is beside the tray and the left remains off to the left.

observed_sequence.action: Both hands are open and stationary beside the shelf; cube rests on lowest wooden tray.
Right forearm advances toward cube, positioning open thumb and fingers on opposing sides; left hand remains idle.
Right fingers close around cube while it remains at the lowest tray; hand settles its grasp.
Right hand lifts the cube clear of the lower tray and carries it upward and to the right toward the highest wooden shelf.
Right hand carries cube over the highest shelf and lowers it toward the wooden surface, retaining visible finger contact.
Right fingers begin opening around the cube at the highest shelf; hand stays immediately around it at the final frame.

arm_hand_roles.right: Sole manipulating hand: closes fingers around cube, lifts from bottom tray, transports to highest shelf, lowers and starts opening fingers.
arm_hand_roles.left: Open and idle throughout; no cube contact, stabilization or transfer.

The active forearm extends from the robot's right body side rather than an opposing robot facing the camera.
anatomical_side_evidence.uncertainty: Shoulders and full torso are outside this egocentric view, but bilateral own-arm attachment direction and palm orientation establish the convention.
